# has illustrator

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasIllustrator`](gmeow-hasIllustrator.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasIllustrator>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a creative work to an agent that contributed visual illustrations. A flat shortcut subproperty of [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasIllustrator`](gmeow-hasIllustrator.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md), [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case of naming an illustrator; often attaches at the [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) or [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) tier where the illustrations live (an illustrated edition).

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the illustration's period, degree, or evidence must be first-class (promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) with [`gmeow:roleIllustrator`](../individuals/gmeow-roleIllustrator.md)), and avoid it for cover art (use [`gmeow:roleCoverArtist`](../individuals/gmeow-roleCoverArtist.md) via a [`Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md)).

### How to use

- Assert from the illustrated work to the agent; promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) carrying [`gmeow:roleIllustrator`](../individuals/gmeow-roleIllustrator.md) when metadata is needed.

### Examples

- ex:alicePenguinEd [`gmeow:hasIllustrator`](gmeow-hasIllustrator.md) ex:tenniel.
